summary: Feed s086_single to IDS is degraded: 50% of packets are untagged and required VLAN 20 is completely missing, creating a coverage gap for IDS detection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or filtering VLAN 20 before delivery. 50% untagged indicates VLAN tags removed or native VLAN misconfiguration, and VLAN 20 never arrives at tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to all traffic on VLAN 20 (50% of feed). Cannot detect intrusions, lateral movement, or policy violations on that segment; correlation and VLAN-aware signatures fail.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags and ensure VLANs 10 and 20 are both forwarded to IDS port to meet tool profile requirement and restore full detection coverage.
